Summary

2026-06-02 03:10-09:40 UTC. A failover in eu-west produced a sustained alert storm across the checkout stack. Merchant checkout p99 degraded for 41 minutes.

Timeline

  • 03:10 eu-west failover begins; alert volume spikes
  • 03:22 incident declared (INC-142)
  • 04:05 checkout-db alerts silenced to cut noise
  • 04:41 payments-reconciler alerting turned off pending backlog drain
  • 09:40 all clear
